description: Hook manifest for Release 1B. All hook source paths, SHA-256 hashes, probe routes, probe methods, and expected post-removal statuses are UNRESOLVED and must be provided by operators before --run. See defect-15 and defect-16 corrections in release1b_round14_review.md.

onboarding.description: Patient onboarding hook. Handles antenatal phase enrollment and routing. Defect-18 fix: this hook's route is for patient-facing onboarding flow, not a prohibited or admin route.
onboarding.removal_status_rationale: Route is hook-exclusive; disappears when hook is removed
onboarding.defect_15_note: HOOK_PROBE_ROUTES[onboarding] must be set to the actual hook route before --run

push_broadcast.description: Push notification broadcast hook. Sends push notifications to users. Authorized exclusion E6: requires external push service credentials.
push_broadcast.removal_status_rationale: Route is hook-exclusive; disappears when hook is removed
push_broadcast.authorized_exclusion: E6-PUSH-BROADCAST: external push service credentials not available in isolated harness

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp integration hook. Authorized exclusion E8: requires production API key.
whatsapp.removal_status_rationale: Route is hook-exclusive; disappears when hook is removed
whatsapp.authorized_exclusion: E8-WHATSAPP: production WhatsApp API key not available in isolated harness

alias_intercept.description: Alias account intercept hook. Intercepts auth-with-password requests for alias accounts and returns 400. This hook may share the auth route with PocketBase core, making the expected post-removal status non-trivially 404.
alias_intercept.removal_status_rationale: UNRESOLVED: route may be shared with PocketBase core auth; baseline behavior after hook removal requires operator specification. Defect-16 fix: this is the interceptor case requiring non-404 baseline.
alias_intercept.defect_16_note: HOOK_EXPECTED_REMOVED_STATUS[alias_intercept] is UNRESOLVED — interceptor hooks require separate baseline verification

global_constants_required.HOOK_SRC_PATHS: All four keys must be set to valid file paths before --run
global_constants_required.HOOK_EXPECTED_SHA256: All four keys must be set to valid SHA-256 hashes before --run
global_constants_required.HOOK_PROBE_ROUTES: All four keys must be set; defect-28 fix enforces key-set match with HOOK_SRC_PATHS
global_constants_required.HOOK_PROBE_METHODS: Defaults provided in script; override as needed

defect_28_requirement: pb_check_package_completeness() verifies that HOOK_PROBE_ROUTES keys exactly match HOOK_SRC_PATHS keys. No extras, no missing. This check runs in --package-check mode.
